title: Vibrant Smoky Croatian Chicken Skewers
description: A nutty and bouncy post-workout Croatian dish featuring Sichuan pepper and smoke, prepared on a slate tile vessel, this recipe is ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly and perfect for a snack or dinner.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the toasted Sichuan pepper, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the spice mixture.
Thread the chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and grill for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice and minced garlic.
Brush the lemon-garlic mixture onto the skewers during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Remove the skewers from the grill and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the skewers hot on a slate tile vessel, with your choice of sides.
